verdict.rationale: Check ships a CLI, an MCP server, and a SaaS console, so the ability to opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry opt-out, a do-not-track setting, or any usage-tracking controls. The Components event emission (check-docs-8) is a developer analytics feature, not an opt-out, and the community complaint about mandatory privacy-policy acceptance points the opposite way rather than showing an opt-out.
